extracted.name: Mom's Warm Milk
extracted.description: When my boys had a hard time getting to sleep I came up with this warm milk to help calm them. Even now years after they began drinking it. They still enjoy it during homework, or coming in from a cold day of play. I too have drank it after a long days work. I hope you enjoy this recipe as well for years to come.
instruction_lines: In a large mug, stir together the milk, vanilla and sugar. Heat in the microwave on full power for 1 minute and 30 seconds. Stir in nutmeg, and serve hot.
